initial-dialogue.npc: I've been tracking gemstones, and I think I've found a potential source for them!

steps.npc: It moves around a bit, but look! It's right here with us at the moment!

initial-dialogue.text: If the gemstone crab is not nearby:

steps.player: Right... And where is this crab?

steps.npc: Hello again! Look! That large crab is here!

subsequent-dialogue.text: If the gemstone crab is not nearby:

steps.player: Do you happen to know where that large crab is?

steps.npc: I believe it's currently to the north!

steps.npc: I believe it's currently to the north east!

historical-dialogue-avium-savannah-first.npc: Come on... Something here has to work...
Absolutely! I can't seem to find a way into that crevice to continue my scientific endeavour. I don't suppose you could have a dig around?

historical-dialogue-avium-savannah-first.player: A scientific dig... Where have I heard of that before?

historical-dialogue-avium-savannah-first.npc: Don't dwell on it too long. There are things I must learn about our world!

historical-dialogue-avium-savannah-after.player: I found a ruby in the ground.

historical-dialogue-avium-savannah-after.npc: Wondrous! A good sign to be sure! You may keep it, while I will keep the knowledge of what may be here.

historical-dialogue-south-of-fortis-colo.npc: So I'm here... That's there... Then how do we get down there?
Ah, hello there! I'm just pondering on the wonders of geography.

historical-dialogue-south-of-fortis-colo.player: Anything I can help you out with?

historical-dialogue-south-of-fortis-colo.npc: Most certainly. Perhaps you could dig around near the mouth of that nearby cave and elucidate its nature for me.

historical-dialogue-south-of-fortis-colo.player: Will I get anything for helping?

historical-dialogue-south-of-fortis-colo.npc: The feeling of satisfaction after helping a scientist in need?
Outstanding! This can only be seen as a positive! I shall add the knowledge to my reserves. You may keep the gem.

historical-dialogue-south-of-ralos-rise-.npc: No, my good friend, but I am in a bit of a pickle.
Perhaps a jam... Those bandits over there are in the way of scientific discovery!

historical-dialogue-south-of-ralos-rise-.player: Would you like me to deal with them?

historical-dialogue-south-of-ralos-rise-.npc: Well, I'm not averse to a little academic collaboration. I just need some proof that there's something strange here.
Is there any chance you could dig near the mouth of that cave for me? Let me know if you find anything.

historical-dialogue-south-of-ralos-rise-.player: What should I do with the bandits?

historical-dialogue-south-of-ralos-rise-.npc: I have no qualms with you doing what you must on that front.

historical-dialogue-south-of-ralos-rise-.player: I found an emerald in the earth.

historical-dialogue-south-of-ralos-rise-.npc: Stupendous! Combined with the other locations, I suspect there may be more to this than meets the eye.
Keep the gem for yourself, as payment for your assistance.
